# BulkOperationExecutor

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.BulkOperationExecutor`

#### AnalyzeBatchFailure

```text
public static System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList`1<PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.BatchFailureDiagnostic> AnalyzeBatchFailure(System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList`1<Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Entity> batch, System.Exception exception)
```

Analyzes a batch failure to identify which record(s) caused the failure.

- Parameter `batch`: The batch of entities that failed.
- Parameter `exception`: The exception that was thrown.

Returns: A list of diagnostics identifying problematic records.

Remarks: When a batch fails with a &quot;Does Not Exist&quot; error, this method: 1. Parses the error message to extract the missing reference ID(s) 2. Scans all records in the batch for EntityReference fields matching those IDs 3. Returns diagnostics identifying which record/field contains the problematic reference Special patterns detected: SELF_REFERENCE: Record references itself (common in hierarchical entities) SAME_BATCH_REFERENCE: Record references another record in the same batch MISSING_REFERENCE: Record references an entity that doesn&#x27;t exist in target

### Properties

#### AdaptiveSizer

```text
PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.AdaptiveBatchSizer AdaptiveSizer { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets an optional adaptive batch sizer that dynamically adjusts batch sizes based on observed execution times. When null, the fixed P:PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.BulkOperationOptions.BatchSize is used for all batches.


#### ThrottleManager

```text
PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.AdaptiveThrottleManager ThrottleManager { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets an optional adaptive throttle manager that dynamically adjusts the degree of parallelism based on 429 (service protection limit) responses. When null, throttle events are handled by the existing retry logic without adjusting parallelism. Complementary to P:PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.BulkOperationExecutor.AdaptiveSizer: that adjusts batch SIZE, this adjusts thread COUNT.
